exposure: Use of psychotropic medications during pregnancy
cohort: Pregnant women with psychiatric disorders who were referred to the Department of Neuropsychiatry at Ehime University Hospital from January 2014 to December 2022, 194 of whom gave birth at the hospital.
finding: The use of psychotropic medications during the perinatal period appeared safe and beneficial for both pregnant women with psychiatric disorders and their children, showing no relationship with Apgar scores, breastfeeding choices, or congenital malformations, though gestational weeks at birth were associated with birth weight and Apgar score.
